summary: Issue 5 — Resource Efficiency Review. Page 1: Classification Update. Astra's accurate Issue 4 report has acquired a corporate category.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Morning in the operations bullpen. Every terminal refreshes at once with a corporate review banner.
PANEL 2 — Pixa lights up.
PANEL 3 — Astra freezes mid-coffee.
PANEL 4 — Glorp scrolls through the new classification tree.
PANEL 5 — Jax looks over.

summary: Page 2: The Opportunity. Pilot status offers expedited procurement, creating a real reason for Astra to cooperate.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Close on the new station status.
PANEL 2 — Mira reads it.
PANEL 3 — Pixa opens the pilot-benefits section.
PANEL 4 — The still-open bracket request appears beside it.
PANEL 5 — Astra looks toward Zib.
PANEL 6 — Zib sees the look immediately.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIXA
dialogueInline.text: Pilot sites receive expedited procurement eligibility.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: Don't look at me like that.

summary: Page 3: The Collection Bins. Corporate optimization arrives as physical equipment before anyone arrives in person.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Delivery drones unload sleek gray passive-recovery and sample-holding containers.
PANEL 2 — Zib stares at them.
PANEL 3 — Pixa scans the manifest.
PANEL 4 — Jax peers into a bin.
PANEL 5 — Glorp reads the attached instruction packet.
PANEL 6 — Kreeb studies the sentence.

dialogueInline.speaker: SIGN
dialogueInline.text: PASSIVE RESIDUE RECOVERY / MATERIAL SAMPLE HOLDING / INCIDENT TRACE COLLECTION.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: This looks like a future lawsuit with handles.

dialogueInline.speaker: SCREEN
dialogueInline.text: Please encourage naturally occurring production opportunities.

dialogueInline.speaker: KREEB
dialogueInline.text: That phrase is trying very hard not to say what it means.

summary: Page 4: The Packet Is Wrong. Mira catches the unsupported leap from physical material observations to staff-condition language.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira reads the science section at speed.
PANEL 2 — She stops.
PANEL 3 — The packet contains a requested staff-condition field.
PANEL 4 — Astra gestures toward the newly delivered bins.
PANEL 5 — Mira points at the packet.
PANEL 6 — Astra lowers her voice.

dialogueInline.speaker: SCREEN
dialogueInline.text: CORRELATE STAFF CONDITION WITH COHESION OUTPUT.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: The bins are ugly. This is wrong.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Can we answer the material part without answering the people part?

summary: Page 5: Resource Communication Liaison. Jax accepts the role because it is a concrete bounded job.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Pixa projects an automated staffing recommendation naming Jax as resource communication liaison.
PANEL 2 — Jax reads it carefully instead of recoiling.
PANEL 3 — Pixa lists the duties: upload sample logs; confirm chain of custody; answer routing requests; maintain collection access.
PANEL 4 — Jax looks at Astra.
PANEL 5 — Astra nods.
PANEL 6 — Jax takes the packet Glorp offers him and feels its weight.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: Fine. Give me the job description.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: Why is it heavier than the sample?

summary: Page 6: Passive Only. The local rule permits material collection during normal work and explicitly refuses inferred emotion fields.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra, Mira, Glorp, and Kreeb write a local collection rule around one terminal.
PANEL 2 — Astra states the boundary.
PANEL 3 — Mira adds another boundary.
PANEL 4 — Glorp points at the corporate context form.
PANEL 5 — Kreeb reads the field.
PANEL 6 — Glorp looks genuinely troubled.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Material goes in the bin if it forms during normal work. Nothing gets scheduled to make it form.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: Then how do we complete field 7B?

summary: Page 7: Collection Starts. Passive collection yields immediately to ordinary maintenance access.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The bins are placed only where they do not obstruct ordinary work.
PANEL 2 — Jax labels the first empty container and opens the custody log.
PANEL 3 — Zib shifts one bin away from a maintenance panel.
PANEL 4 — Pixa notices.
PANEL 5 — Zib opens the panel cleanly.
PANEL 6 — Mira labels the collection context with only physical data: location, time, temperature, equipment load, sample mass.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: Record that it was blocking access.

summary: Page 8: Measurement Changes the Room. A visible context dashboard changes behavior merely by being visible; Mira reports that measurement effect rather than interpreting anyone's feelings.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — A corporate-requested context dashboard is visible in the bullpen. People become conspicuously self-conscious around it.
PANEL 2 — Jax watches a conversation die when someone notices the screen.
PANEL 3 — Pixa removes the dashboard from public view.
PANEL 4 — Normal conversation gradually resumes while people work.
PANEL 5 — Mira watches the change.

dialogueInline.speaker: SCREEN
dialogueInline.text: SPEAKER TURNS / TASK INTERRUPTIONS / COLLECTION EVENTS.

summary: Page 9: Panel Wins. A collection bin loses a compliance fight to actual service access.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — A bin has drifted back in front of a service access point.
PANEL 2 — Zib moves it immediately.
PANEL 3 — A collection-location noncompliance notification appears.
PANEL 4 — Glorp checks the clock.
PANEL 5 — Zib opens the service panel.
PANEL 6 — Astra closes the notice. Pixa records a local access override.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: We have been noncompliant for forty-three seconds.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: We have been able to open this for four.

summary: Page 10: First Day. Low mass and mixed cohesion become a corporate 'promising early indicator' before there is a useful pattern.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Pixa displays the first passive-collection totals.
PANEL 2 — Mira reviews the samples.
PANEL 3 — Astra leans in.
PANEL 4 — Mira looks pleased by the answer.
PANEL 5 — Corporate status immediately updates.
PANEL 6 — Mira stares at it.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: Low mass. Mixed cohesion. No useful pattern yet.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: Too low for anybody to get excited.

summary: Page 11: The Language Board. Brick and Glorp notice that the paperwork's appetite expanded after Stardust's report entered the system.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Brick has pinned printed corporate phrases to a board.
PANEL 2 — Glorp studies the packet beside him.
PANEL 3 — Glorp does not look up.
PANEL 4 — Glorp notices that several staff-condition fields were added after Stardust's report entered the review system.
PANEL 5 — Brick points at the routing history.
PANEL 6 — Glorp corrects him.

dialogueInline.speaker: BRICK
dialogueInline.text: Potential is appetite wearing a tie.

summary: Page 12: Actual Work. A real damper alert interrupts review chatter; the crew finishes the job before collecting incidental residue.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — An ordinary station alert interrupts the review chatter.
PANEL 2 — Zib is already moving.
PANEL 3 — Jax picks up his access log and reader without being asked.
PANEL 4 — Mira takes the diagnostic sensor.
PANEL 5 — Astra looks at the nearby collection bin, then at the maintenance team.
PANEL 6 — As the work proceeds, a small amount of residue appears along a warm cable seam. Nobody stops the repair to collect it.

summary: Page 13: After the Work. Only after the damper is operating normally does Jax collect the sample; Mira refuses a causal claim.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The damper is operating normally again.
PANEL 2 — Only after the repair is complete does Jax collect the incidental residue and close the custody entry.
PANEL 3 — Mira tests the sample later at the bench.
PANEL 4 — She looks at Astra.
PANEL 5 — Astra asks the question that now matters most.
PANEL 6 — Mira shakes her head.

summary: Page 14: The Line We Can Live Behind. Astra and Mira state the real institutional dilemma: unmeasurable stations disappear; measurable stations get optimized.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra and Mira stand beside the temporary bracket request and the new pilot status screen.
PANEL 2 — Astra points at the procurement benefit.
PANEL 3 — Mira points at the staff-condition fields.
PANEL 4 — Astra answers honestly.
PANEL 5 — Mira answers just as honestly.
PANEL 6 — Astra looks at the two screens.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Pilot status could move our parts queue.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: And the wrong explanation could turn everyone here into a variable.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Stations without measurable value disappear quietly.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: Stations with measurable value get optimized.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: Then what are you asking me?

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Help me find the line we can live behind.

summary: Page 15: Suggested Enhancement. The optional pilot recommendation quietly turns into behavioral intervention with consequences.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — A new Resource Efficiency recommendation arrives.
PANEL 2 — The recommendation lists three enhancement pathways.
PANEL 3 — Mira reads it.
PANEL 4 — Kreeb reads the same list.
PANEL 5 — Glorp finds the administrative note.
PANEL 6 — Pixa displays the consequence.

dialogueInline.speaker: SCREEN
dialogueInline.text: structured collaboration window; wellness baseline; scheduled team activity blocks.

summary: Page 16: What Each of Them Will Defend. Astra collects concrete operational objections rather than staging a grand vote.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The crew does not hold a grand vote. Astra asks for the operational objections she needs before signing anything.
PANEL 2 — Zib points toward maintenance.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb keeps the language simple.
PANEL 4 — Mira points at the unsupported model.
PANEL 5 — Glorp holds up the custody procedure.
PANEL 6 — Jax holds his completed first-day liaison log. Astra takes all of it in.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: Don't schedule work to feed a bin.

dialogueInline.speaker: KREEB
dialogueInline.text: Do not make care an input.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: We cannot defend a behavioral mechanism.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: We can defend passive chain of custody.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: And I can actually do that job.

summary: Page 17: Material Yes, People No. Astra accepts passive collection and knowingly refuses behavioral intervention even at the cost of pilot advantage.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra completes the response form.
PANEL 2 — She approves passive material collection.
PANEL 3 — She refuses behavioral intervention.
PANEL 4 — Mira looks at Astra.
PANEL 5 — Astra does not soften the language. Glorp starts to speak; Astra stops him and sends it.

summary: Page 18: Baseline. Corporate accepts the boundary but makes a standardized wellness baseline the next pilot gate.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Corporate acknowledgement arrives.
PANEL 2 — A second line makes pilot eligibility conditional.
PANEL 3 — Astra leans toward the screen.
PANEL 4 — Pixa opens the attached corporate program.
PANEL 5 — Mira reads the description.
PANEL 6 — Glorp finds the policy source.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: That is a behavioral intervention with better branding.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: It is company-wide wellness policy. Declining it is a different form.

summary: Page 19: What They Actually Won. The crew did not prevent the wellness week, but they did hold the behavioral-production boundary.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra and Mira remain at the terminal after everyone else moves on.
PANEL 2 — Astra points at the mandatory baseline notice.
PANEL 3 — Mira points back at the accepted boundary.
PANEL 4 — Astra considers that.
PANEL 5 — Mira continues.
PANEL 6 — Astra gives her a look.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: They did not get the intervention they asked for.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: A week we can measure without pretending it proves anything.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: You make bad news sound peer reviewed.

summary: Page 20: Jax Files the Job. Jax completes the liaison task literally and prefers the version without emotional fields.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Jax uploads the passive sample custody report.
PANEL 2 — Pixa confirms it.
PANEL 3 — Jax scrolls through the finished form.
PANEL 4 — Pixa answers literally.
PANEL 5 — Jax closes the file.
PANEL 6 — Glorp looks over immediately.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIXA
dialogueInline.text: None required by the local boundary.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: I like this job better now.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: Do not say that near staffing.

summary: Page 21: One Sign. Collection access, passive-only policy, and readable local procedure get condensed into one usable rule.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib relocates the collection bins to a proper rack that does not obstruct service access.
PANEL 2 — Kreeb adds a simple label.
PANEL 3 — Glorp adds a second access label.
PANEL 4 — The two labels overlap badly.
PANEL 5 — Astra sees them.
PANEL 6 — Glorp and Kreeb reluctantly combine the rules into one readable card while Mira watches. Pixa emits a notification tone.

dialogueInline.speaker: SIGN
dialogueInline.text: DO NOT MOVE WITHOUT ACCESS CHECK.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: That may be our best data control.

summary: Page 22: Tag — Wellness Baseline. The next issue arrives as a standardized company program, causally attached to the boundary the crew just chose.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — A cheerful corporate banner automatically unrolls across the bullpen.
PANEL 2 — Everyone looks up at it.
PANEL 3 — Zib studies the mounting points.
PANEL 4 — Pixa checks its placement.
PANEL 5 — Zib keeps looking at it.
